## About
Clever Home llc started out as Clever Interiors Inc. and was renamed when the company relocated and expanded. The owner brings experience from the New York City Hi-End renovation industry to homes here in Marietta.
We're a fully certified and insured company, and we partner with certified subcontractors for any trade that Georgia law obliges. Whether it's a kitchen, a bathroom, a deck or a full renovation, Karls works with the materials and styles you like and helps you turn your ideas into something real.
Our neighbors have given us a 5 rating from 41 Google reviews, and past clients have called us back for their next project.

## Services
- Kitchens: We guide you with design and cabinetry distribution to maximize space and workable area, with the best flow and organization for your kitchen.
- Bathrooms: No matter the size, the right alterations and material combination can turn your bathroom into your own spa.
- Customs Renovations: Custom furniture or a special custom piece that reflects your personality and makes the space stand out.
- Decks and Porches: Decks, roofs and screened in porches built around how you want to use your outdoor space.
- Design Consultation: Help with design and planning so your ideas work in the room you have.
- Full Renovations: Whole floor gut and renovation work, carried from planning through execution to the final product.

## FAQ
Q: Are you insured?
A: Yes. Clever Home llc is a fully certified and insured company.

Q: Who handles trades like plumbing or electrical?
A: We partner with certified subcontractors for any trade that Georgia law requires.

Q: Do you take on smaller jobs?
A: Yes. We help with minor updates as well as larger scale projects.

Q: Can you work within my budget?
A: One reviewer said Karls can make your particular idea come true within your budget range, and another said their kitchen came in on budget.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM, and closed Sunday.
